mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(CONCAT('sku:', NULLIF(TRIM(a.seller_sku), '')), CONCAT('ozon:', NULLIF(TRIM(a.ozon_sku), '')), CONCAT('name:', NULLIF(TRIM(a.product_name), '')), 'unknown') AS product_key, COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.product_name), '')), '未标注商品') AS product_name, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(a.seller_sku), '')) AS seller_sku, COALESCE(DATE_FORMAT(s.accrual_date, '%Y-%m'), '未知月份') AS report_month, SUM(a.total_amount_rub) AS sales_amount_rub FROM ozon_accruals a INNER JOIN () s ON s.accrual_id = a.accrual_id WHERE a.total_amount_rub > 0 AND s.total_amount_rub <> 0 GROUP BY product_key, report_month ORDER BY report_month, product_key
mapper.sql: COALESCE(CONCAT('sku:', NULLIF(TRIM(a.seller_sku), '')), CONCAT('ozon:', NULLIF(TRIM(a.ozon_sku), '')), CONCAT('name:', NULLIF(TRIM(a.product_name), '')), 'unknown')
mapper.select: SELECT product_key, MAX(product_name) AS product_name, MAX(seller_sku) AS seller_sku, COUNT(*) AS sale_count, SUM(sales_amount_rub) AS sales_amount_rub FROM () sales GROUP BY product_key ORDER BY sale_count DESC, product_key
ORDER BY sale_date IS NULL, sale_date, row_id
